title: Evaluation of a circuit difference
statement: Let $C$ and $C'$ be algebraic circuits on the same finite set of inputs, each with at least one gate, and let the inputs take values in a commutative ring. The circuit formed by adjoining the shifted gates of $C'$ to those of $C$ and then subtracting their output nodes evaluates to the value of $C$ minus the value of $C'$.
